Logic drives the MOSFET gate through R35; R36 pulls the logic input toward ground. No galvanic isolation.
D11 clamps between switched return (anode) and supply positive (cathode); observe source polarity.
JP1.2 VCC is isolated in this source circuit; it is not the external load-supply input.
